endpoint.title: Local MOTIS endpoint URL
endpoint.description: Base URL of a self-hosted MOTIS server. Leave blank to rely on the `motis` service registry entry.

transitousUrl.title: Transitous endpoint URL
transitousUrl.description: Base URL of the cloud Transitous instance (fallback when local MOTIS is unreachable).

dataSources.name: Transitous
dataSources.license: Mixed (per upstream GTFS/GBFS feed; mostly open data)
dataSources.attribution: Public transport data via Transitous — see transitous.org/sources/
dataSources.notes: The Transitous public API (api.transitous.org) is 'not intended for commercial or for-profit purposes' — commercial use is decided case-by-case on request, and open-source clients must publish their source and visibly link transitous.org/sources/ for attribution (see transitous.org/api/). The MOTIS routing software is AGPL-3.0-or-later, but that licenses the software, not the data; the aggregated timetable data is per upstream feed (mostly CC-BY / CC-BY-SA / open-government licences).
